description: This file defines the NotesDao class, which provides various methods for accessing and manipulating note data within a local SQLite database in a Flutter app. It includes methods for querying, updating, synchronization, and observing notes, and interacts with notes and synchronization state.

classes.name: NotesDao
classes.description: A data access object for notes, providing methods to query, update, synchronize, and observe notes in the database.

methods.name: watchNotes
methods.description: Returns a stream of note lists matching a query, updating when changes occur.

methods.name: watchNoteById
methods.description: Returns a stream with a specific note by ID, updating on database changes.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Fetches a single note by its ID.

methods.name: upsertLocal
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a note in the local database.

methods.name: markDeleted
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted and updates the timestamp.

methods.name: setSyncStatus
methods.description: Sets the synchronization status for a list of notes.

methods.name: getNotesForPush
methods.description: Retrieves notes that need to be pushed to remote.

methods.name: reconcileRemoteNotes
methods.description: Reconciles remote notes with local, applying remote data based on updated timestamps.

methods.name: purgeSyncedTombstones
methods.description: Deletes notes that are deleted, clean, and synced.

methods.name: _queryNotes
methods.description: Executes a query to retrieve notes matching a search term.

methods.name: _escapeLike
methods.description: Escapes special characters in search queries for LIKE statement.

methods.name: _mapRow
methods.description: Maps a database row to a Note object.

methods.name: _toRow
methods.description: Converts a Note object to a database row map.
